## Summary

Financial claims and recommendations below are attributed to this September 25, 2026 report and its supplied September 24 technical snapshot. They are preserved historical claims, forecasts and conditions, not current market facts.[^hmsp-3b2ef84f3f7b15d1]

Rank 1 is No actionable strategy: the countertrend reversal is unconfirmed and the illustrative 655/630/687.50 structure yields 1.30:1, below the Moderate floor. The conservative first-zone edge 675 yields 0.80:1. Rank 2 rejects breakout-and-hold above 655; RSI/stochastic must improve and CMF/OBV strengthen, followed by supported hold/retest and later-session limit execution. Maximum buy and executable tactical stop are unavailable. The favorable 700 point yields 1.80:1, but cannot rescue the weak primary target; lower-confidence 735–770 also cannot justify entry. Last hypothetical entry is session 7, October 6; a three-holding-session follow-through review must fit before expiry. Official excise/company shocks and loss of closing support 630 cancel the thesis.[^hmsp-3b2ef84f3f7b15d1]

The report keeps signals separate from fills: Waiting is the stated cut-off condition; Armed/Triggered need fresh dated observations, Active needs explicit entry execution, and Completed needs fills closing the full position. Target touches or exit deadlines alone do not prove execution. Terminal scenario probabilities cannot establish conditional target/stop/fill probabilities, so strategy expected value is not reliably estimable. Unknown costs are not zero and capital, currency-risk, lot and execution inputs do not support a share quantity.[^hmsp-3b2ef84f3f7b15d1]
